name: Hektar Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: Hektar REIT 在 2026 年完成两项教育物业的收购与回租（Lot 9807 和 Lot 9808），并推进以 1.25 亿令吉收购 KYS KL East International School 物业及回租的计划；同时拟收购槟城 Bayan Lepas 一幅工业用地及厂房并回租，以扩展工业板块。此外，拟收购 Terramark 90% 股权以开发 Perlis Chuping 太阳能农场，但一项先前公布的收购因卖方未满足先决条件而终止。
overview_en: In 2026, Hektar REIT completed the acquisition and leaseback of two education properties (Lot 9807 and Lot 9808) and is proceeding with the proposed acquisition and leaseback of the KYS KL East International School property for RM125.00 million. It also proposed to acquire and lease back an industrial land and factory in Bayan Lepas, Penang, to expand its industrial segment.

segments.name: 教育物业
segments.note: 今年完成两项教育用地及建筑的收购与回租，并推进吉隆坡 KYS KL East International School 物业的收购与回租。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition and leaseback of two education land and buildings this year, and is progressing with the proposed acquisition and leaseback of the KYS KL East International School property i…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准最多 42,075,256 个代价单位的上市及报价，须符合公众持股量等条件。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of up to 42,075,256 consideration units, subject to conditions including public security holding spread.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述收购与回租向 Bursa Securities 提交上市申请，以发行代价单位。
actions.text_en: Submitted the listing application to Bursa Securities for the issuance of consideration units in relation to the proposed acquisition and lease.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 1.25 亿令吉收购吉隆坡 Setapak 的 KYS KL East International School 物业（含现有建筑及新建建筑）并回租，代价以 1.0655 亿令吉现金及发行新单位支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition and leaseback of the KYS KL East International School property in Setapak, Kuala Lumpur (including existing buildings and a new building) for RM125.00 million, satisfied via RM106.55 million cash and issuance of new units.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以收购及回租方式完成 Lot 9807（6.3 英亩土地）的收购，交易于 2026 年 5 月 8 日视为完成。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition and leaseback of Lot 9807 (6.3 acres), deemed completed on 8 May 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以收购及回租方式完成 Lot 9808（35.5 英亩部分土地）的收购，交易于 2026 年 4 月 17 日视为完成。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition and leaseback of part of Lot 9808 (35.5 acres), deemed completed on 17 April 2026.

segments.name: 工业物业
segments.note: 今年拟收购槟城 Bayan Lepas 一幅工业用地及厂房并回租，以扩展工业板块。
segments.note_en: Proposed to acquire and lease back an industrial land and factory in Bayan Lepas, Penang, this year to expand the industrial segment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟向 Microlead Precision Technology Sdn Bhd 收购槟城 Barat Daya 一幅约 7,657 平方米的租赁工业用地及厂房（作工业、仓储及办公用途）并回租。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition and leaseback from Microlead Precision Technology Sdn Bhd of a leasehold industrial land of approximately 7,657 square meters in Barat Daya, Penang, with factory buildings for industrial, warehousing and office purposes.

segments.name: 太阳能农场开发
segments.note: 今年拟收购 Terramark 90% 股权，以开发 Perlis Chuping 的太阳能农场。
segments.note_en: Proposed to acquire a 90% equity stake in Terramark this year for solar farm development in Chuping, Perlis.

actions.title: OTHERS
actions.text: 拟收购 Terramark Sdn Bhd 90% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of a 90% equity stake in Terramark Sdn Bhd, which holds a strategic land parcel in Chuping, Perlis for solar farm development.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年一项先前公布的收购因卖方未满足先决条件而终止。
segments.note_en: A previously announced acquisition was terminated this year due to the vendors' non-fulfillment of conditions precedent.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 终止一项先前公布的买卖协议，因卖方未满足若干关键先决条件，定金将退还予受托人。
actions.text_en: Terminated a previously announced sale and purchase agreement due to the vendors' non-fulfillment of several key conditions precedent; the deposit will be refunded to the trustee.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟通过收购槟城 Bayan Lepas 工业用地及厂房并回租，新增工业物业板块。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to add an industrial property segment through the acquisition and leaseback of an industrial land and factory in Bayan Lepas, Penang.

model_changes.title: OTHERS
model_changes.text: 拟通过收购 Terramark 90% 股权，新增太阳能农场开发业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to add a solar farm development business through the acquisition of a 90% stake in Terramark.
